create_colorlogger: create a colorlogger instance that writes colored logs to a directory and console
log_info_message: log an info message with a green timestamp to both file and console
log_warning_message: log a warning message with a yellow WRN prefix to both file and console
log_error_message: log an error message with a red ERR prefix to both file and console
log_critical_message: log a critical message with a red CRI prefix to both file and console
